name: v1.1.0 last tensorflow release & PyTorch
body:
## What's Changed
* Bump tensorflow version by @stes in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/103
* Fix #112 - don't subset cpuinfo by @sneakers-the-rat in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/114
* Introduce CI/CD for TensorFLow version  by @maximpavliv in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/122
* Update README & benchmarking script by @MMathisLab in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/126
* Update pyproject.toml by @MMathisLab in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/125
* Update benchmark.py by @MMathisLab in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/123
* Bump pillow from 11.2.1 to 11.3.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/129
* Bump werkzeug from 3.1.3 to 3.1.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/142
* Bump urllib3 from 2.4.0 to 2.6.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/141
* Update version to 1.1.0 by @Copilot in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/147
* chore: type hints for benchmark by @sneakers-the-rat in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/117
* Bump torch from 2.7.1 to 2.8.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/145
* [WIP] Integration with DeepLabCut 3.0 - PyTorch Engine by @n-poulsen in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/121
* update pytorch models following DeepLabCut 3.0.0rc13 by @deruyter92 in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/151
* Fix GitHub Actions disk space exhaustion on Ubuntu runners by @deruyter92 in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/153
* add modelzoo functionality by @deruyter92 in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/152
* Remove unused & duplicated TF files by @C-Achard in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/154
* Additional testing by @C-Achard in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/156
* Update GitHub Actions workflow for PyPI release by @MMathisLab in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/158

## New Contributors
* @stes made their first contribution in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/103
* @C-Achard made their first contribution in https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/pull/154

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DeepLabCut/DeepLabCut-live/compare/v1.0.4...v1.1.0
